title: German Register for Rare Diseases (DeRSE)- Database for patients with rare and unclear diseases
summary:
The aim of the project is to initially collect the clinical data of participating patients with an unclear illness and the presence of a rare disease prospectively in a structured form so that it is then available in pseudonymized form for specific questions. 
Personal details, medical data including questions from the psychosomatic spectrum are to be recorded in the prospective database. Patient data is collected when an application is made and for quality assurance purposes as part of any follow-up examinations. These are stored pseudonymously.
conditions: Patients with unclear disease and suspected rare disease

interventions.name:
Patients with unclear disease and suspected rare disease.
It is planned to enter personal details and medical data (e.g. age and gender, height and weight, previous illnesses, course of the illness over time with complications, laboratory results, findings from examinations and treatments, details

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All patients who have undergone the standardized procedure of the Department for Rare Diseases and have given their consent are to be included. Adults, children and adolescents living in Germany will be considered. Requests from abroad are not included in the database.
Exclusion criteria:
Requests from abroad are not included in the database.
